note: The two sets are nearly identical; Set B adds one further claim — the (1) 2-1/4" heavy hex nut at the pin connection — which is supported by the text layer ('(1) 2-1/4"', 'HEAVY HEX', 'NUT') and is a real engineering item. Both sets share the same flaw: the 'threaded rod | length | up to 12 in' claim misbinds the 12" maximum elevation difference as a rod length (the rod is explicitly 'OF VARYING LENGTHS'). Both also repeat several facts under two names (neoprene pad thickness, PL3 1/2X3 1/2X1/4 size/thickness, C3X6 as both 'C3X6' and 'Channel', W8X10 as both 'W8X10' and 'beam', HSS4X4X1/4 twice).
remarks: Shared misbinding: 'threaded rod | length | up to 12 in' — the 12" is the maximum elevation difference the varying-length rod accommodates, not a length. Shared duplicates: neoprene pad thickness, PL3 1/2X3 1/2X1/4 (thickness and size), C3X6 (as 'C3X6' and 'Channel'), W8X10 (as 'W8X10' and 'beam'), HSS4X4X1/4 (size and wall thickness). Both sets omit notable items on the page: 3/4" DIA A325 bolt, 11" DIA x 1/2" PL, 28" DIA X 1/2" PL, 4X4 TEFLON PLATE W/ 2 5/16" HOLE, PL8X3/8", 3/4" PL and 3/8" PL, keeper plate note. Set B's added nut claim labels 2-1/4" as 'diameter' when it is the nominal nut/bolt size, and its quote is reconstructed with an ellipsis joining separate text-layer fragments; acceptable but imprecise.
